import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix island label variants (lowercase and trailing space)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (handle commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric (already numeric but some negatives exist)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Drop rows with negative flipper_length_mm (invalid per rules)
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and sum body_mass_g
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
    return result
